comparison.visualAssessment: PULSAR, ORBITAL and SINGULARITY midpoint comparisons retain fine detail without objectionable blocking at delivery size. Framing unchanged; no neighboring carousel objects.

visualInspection.result: All nine isolated source compositions retain complete stage art at start, midpoint and near end; PULSAR jets fully inside frame. Delivery scales the complete frame without recropping.
visualInspection.limitations: This pass preserves source animation sequences; it does not establish a mathematically periodic or invisible loop boundary. SINGULARITY container timing normalizes by approximately one frame (33 ms); all source frames retained.
